doctors.name: Mrs. Rajeshwari Luther
doctors.bio:
Rajeshwari Luther is a counselling psychologist with over 30 years of experience helping individuals, couples, and families find clarity, resilience, and a renewed sense of self.

Areas of Expertise:
• Relationships/ family therapy
• Mental health & addiction recovery
• Co-dependency & parenting challenges
• Life transitions & everyday well-being
• Corporate mental health & EAP programs

Therapeutic Approaches:
• Talk therapy & narrative therapy
• Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT)
• Art therapy & meditation
• Certified & accredited EFT practitioner

Qualifications:
• Master's in Psychology
• Healthcare Management — ISB Hyderabad
• Addiction Treatment — Hazelden-Betty Ford, USA
• International Certified Addiction Professional (ICAP 1)
• Diploma in Art Therapy

Languages: English, Hindi & Telugu

doctors.name: Ms. Chandni Singh
doctors.bio:
Chandni is a clinical psychologist with 2 years of experience working with children and adults across a range of psychological, emotional and behavioural concerns. She has worked as a Consultant Clinical Psychologist in India and as a Behavioural Specialist in the United States.

She believes therapy should provide a safe, confidential and non-judgemental space where clients feel heard and understood. Her approach is practical and individualised, helping clients develop healthier ways of coping and work towards meaningful, lasting change.

Areas of Expertise:
• Anxiety & stress
• Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
• Emotional & behavioural difficulties
• Alcohol dependence
• Psychological assessment

Therapeutic Approaches:
• Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT)
• Exposure & Response Prevention (ERP)
• Counselling & therapeutic support

Languages: English & Hindi
